title: Introduction to Drone Components
description: Overview of the main parts of a drone: frame, motors, ESCs, flight controller and battery. Learn what each component does.

title: Understanding Flight Controllers
description: Deep dive into flight controllers — how they work, popular options, and how to configure basic settings for your first build.

title: Assembling Your First Drone
description: Step-by-step assembly guide — soldering ESCs, mounting motors, connecting the flight controller and securing the frame.

title: Pre-flight Safety Checklist
description: Essential safety procedures before every flight — checking props, battery voltage, motor direction, and failsafe settings.

title: Basic Piloting Techniques
description: Learn throttle control, hovering, yaw, pitch and roll. Practice routines for building muscle memory as a beginner pilot.

title: Maintenance and Troubleshooting
description: How to inspect and replace broken props, diagnose motor issues, re-solder connections and keep your drone in top condition.
